close_reason:
Applied the bead's main proposal:
- BlobLookupEntry.id: String -> Id
- BlobLookupEntry.matched_ids: HashMap<String, Vec<String>> -> HashMap<String, Vec<Id>>
- BlobLookupResponse.not_found: Vec<String> -> Vec<Id>

Stretch goal (typed DataTypeName enum for matched_ids keys) deferred — those are externally-defined JMAP data-type names not uniformly enumerable across extensions, and BodyType/ChatMemberRole/QuotaScope precedents are for fixed enum sets. The keys stay String with updated rustdoc explaining why.

Wire format unchanged (Id is #[serde(transparent)] over String). Existing extras-preservation tests don't access the changed fields, so they pass unchanged. cargo test green, clippy clean, fmt clean.

Committed as be72d16.
description:
Files:
- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/blob.rs:24 (`BlobLookupEntry.id: String`)
- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/blob.rs:27 (`BlobLookupEntry.matched_ids: HashMap<String, Vec<String>>`)
- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/blob.rs:50 (`BlobLookupResponse.not_found: Vec<String>`)

Every other id-bearing field in the crate uses `jmap_types::Id` — a `String` newtype that gives type safety against mixing arbitrary strings with JMAP object IDs. Blob.rs is the exception: it uses raw `String` for blob IDs, for the values inside `matched_ids` (which are JMAP message/chat/etc. IDs), and for the `not_found` list.

Caller impact:
- A caller who wants to feed `entry.id` back into another method that takes `&Id` must do `Id::from(&entry.id)` — boilerplate that defeats the type system.
- The keys of `matched_ids` are JMAP data-type names (`"Message"`, `"Chat"`, `"Email"`, …) — these are spec-defined strings, and they too could be typed as a `DataTypeName` enum (with an `Other(String)` for unknown / vendor types) for consistency with `BodyType`, `ChatMemberRole`, etc. patterns elsewhere in the crate.
- Workspace AGENTS.md "Sloppy-Value pattern" rationale does not apply here — these are JMAP-native id values, not externally-owned schema strings.
- Once published, changing `id: String` to `id: Id` is a breaking change that ripples through every consumer.

Fix (additive, applicable now): change `id: String` to `id: Id`, `matched_ids: HashMap<String, Vec<String>>` to `matched_ids: HashMap<String, Vec<Id>>` (or further to `HashMap<DataTypeName, Vec<Id>>`), and `not_found: Vec<String>` to `Vec<Id>`. Workspace AGENTS.md Canonical Templates patterns suggest the chat-client should mirror mail-client; verify mail-client's blob types use `Id` (likely yes) and propagate the convention.

Note: `BlobLookupEntry.matched_ids` exposes `HashMap` as its container choice as well. Changing to `BTreeMap<...>` or to a typed wrapper later is breaking. The same exposure applies to other `Vec<String>` fields in `ChatCapability.supported_body_types`, `Quota.types`, `ChatPushCapability.supported_urgency_values` — those use `Vec<String>` for semantically-typed values (MIME types, JMAP type names, urgency enums) but the audit is filing them separately or via in-scope existing beads.
title: BlobLookupEntry.id and BlobLookupResponse.not_found use String instead of jmap_types::Id
